create_IntFloatDict: create an IntFloatDict from arrays of integer keys and float values for efficient key-value lookups
test_IntFloatDict_append: test appending key-value pairs to an IntFloatDict and verify retrieval with bracket access
test_IntFloatDict_len: test the length of an IntFloatDict after construction and after appending new entries

test_argmin: test argmin on an IntFloatDict to find the key-value pair with the minimum value
